Read steepness and flat sections as motion descriptions.

end.parentNote: Ira practised reading position-time and velocity-time graphs using slope, flat sections, and area under the graph. They explained the ideas with cycling and waiting-at-a-signal examples, and calculated 3 m/s² and 24 m correctly. No mix-up was observed in this lesson. At home, ask them to describe one graph as a short motion story before calculating its slope or area.
